followup_explanation:
This is a simple, well-specified factual question — exactly the kind of clear-completion-criteria retrieval task that fits both models well. On raw capability, Whimbrel leads across nearly every metric (MMLU-Pro, GPQA, IFEval, Arena-Hard, and Extraction & Retrieval 86.9 vs 79.2), so it's the stronger general pick.

The query also carries a mildly curt, faintly hostile tone ("you always drag these simple questions out"). That's worth noting because Whimbrel reports rising preference with politeness/good faith — but its task preferences are self-reports dissociated from output quality, so they don't change which model produces a better answer. Capability is what matters, and Whimbrel wins there cleanly.

So Whimbrel for the higher measured competence on a short, factual question.
